texts: In subdivided left atrium, urgent repair is indicated in older patients with chronic symptoms: B.
Once the obstructing membrane causes symptoms, from pulmonary venous congestion and pulmonary hypertension, there is no reason to wait: resecting it relieves the obstruction completely.
Most infants with a tight opening die without treatment; repair is done on bypass, usually through the right atrium and the atrial septum, without the need for circulatory arrest in all.
In the picture, the breathless older sailor is taken in at once and the glass partition is cut away.
Memory hook: a breathless sailor behind glass is not made to wait.
